$comment: BOTH FIELDS REQUIRED, which is the deliberate opposite of ops-extract. There an empty `required` IS the measurement: a document may genuinely not print a field, and a schema that cannot say so forces every model to invent (measured 2026-08-30, two models of different capability both scoring 2/10 because the contract was deciding). Here every weakness HAS a surface and is or is not blocked, so an omission is a refusal to answer rather than an honest one. The two families pin both halves of the rule: absence must be sayable where absence is real, and required where it is not. `additionalProperties: false` is the same guard as the twin's — with it missing, any object at all validates.
